summary.title: Specifications - OpenMP
summary.one_liner: The OpenMP.org specifications index lists the current and previous OpenMP API versions, reference guides, technical reports and legacy documents, from 1.0 through the 6.1 public comment draft.
keywords: where to download openmp spec pdf
takeaways: The latest technical report listed is TR 15, the public comment draft of OpenMP API 6.1 (July 2026).
Official specifications for 5.1, 5.0, 4.5, 4.0 and 3.x are available as HTML, PDF, reference guides and examples.
Older technical reports (TR1 to TR14) document the evolution toward 5.x and 6.0, such as OMPT, memory management and task reductions.
Legacy documents cover OpenMP Fortran and C/C++ versions 1.0 through 2.5 and their errata.
summary.summary: This is the index page of the official OpenMP specifications on openmp.org. It does not contain the specification text itself; it links to each release, grouped into the latest technical report, previous official specifications, translations, expired technical reports, and legacy documents. The meta description highlights the OpenMP API 6.0 specification (Nov 2024), its errata (Nov 2025), and Amazon softcover volumes covering definitions, directives and clauses, and runtime routines, OMPT and OMPD. The page is a reference listing, so readers should follow the links for the actual content.
